ns2:course.label: Moral Psychology
ns2:course.description: Intensive analysis of issues in the psychological study of morality. Among others topics, the course will cover development of moral judgment, classic and modern outlooks, major theories and recent advances, moral emotions, moral hypocrisy, morality and political ideology, morality and the law, morality and the environment, morality and religion, moral dilemmas, morality in consumer contexts, and the study of praise and blame. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Graduate Students Only.
